reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the Hf coating approach from P7/P9/P34/P36, which studied oxidation resistance of a VZrHfNbTa HEA in air at 1600 °C, to a boride-based component for molten-aluminum corrosion at 700–800 °C. The mechanism (dense HfO2 barrier) and predicted outcome (reduced weight loss) are taken almost verbatim from those passages, and the proposed intervention is the same surface treatment on a different substrate, without a stated reason why it should work against molten aluminum specifically. This is a straightforward application of a known result to a new environment, which constitutes a minor change.
